newsitem.title: USA: Huaneng Power files to offer $200mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Huaneng Power files to offer $200mln in debt.

text.p: Huaneng Power International Inc filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to $200 million in convertible notes due 2004.

The Chinese power plan operator said it will use the proceeds from the sale to help finance a portion of the construction and start-up costs for power plants and for working capital and general corporate needs.
J.P. Morgan Securities Inc will underwrite the offering. They have an over-allotment option of up to $30 million in the notes.
